title: Compilation of conditions
statement: For a condition and a natural-number jump position $l$, compile a comparison of $a$ and $b$ by first compiling $a$ at temporary index $0$ and $b$ at index $1$. For the condition $a<b$, subtract the value in register $0$ from the value in register $1$, subtract the contents of register $-5$, and jump to position $l$ if the result is negative. For the condition $a=b$, subtract the value in register $1$ from the value in register $0$ and jump to $l$ if negative; then replace the result by the contents of register $-7$ minus that result and jump to $l$ if negative.
hypotheses_covered: The condition is either a less-than comparison or an equality comparison of expressions
